svg.title: The same readings, in a different order

cc:Work.dc:title: The same readings, in a different order
cc:Work.dc:description: Synthetic 10-second rate readings over one hour, compared with an exact shuffle. Means, standard deviations and histograms are identical; only the original order has a strong two-minute autocorrelation pattern.
